title: Perfect powers in the product of denominators of elliptic curves
summary: We use sieving arguments to estimate the frequency of $s$-tuples of rational points $$(P_1,\dots,P_s)\in E_1(\mathbb{Q})\times\cdots\times E_s(\mathbb{Q}),$$ where $E_1,\dots,E_s$ are (not necessarily distinct) elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}$, for which the product of their denominators is a perfect $\ell$th power for a fixed prime $\ell$. We consider two settings: one in which the points are of the form $n_iP_i+Q_i$ with $n_i$ ranging over an interval, and another in which we take arbitrary points of bounded canonical height.
